H_key_width.note: the toy key EXCEEDS 64 bits, so a fingerprint match is no longer the whole key and the confirm path is the production path; the false-match RATE is exercised deterministically by H_false_match_confirm

H_shortcycle_exhaustive.note: fixed 64-window boundary-only rule traps every phase of each L|64 cycle; the prime 67 window makes boundaries sweep all residues because gcd(67,L)=1 for every L<=66
H_shortcycle_exhaustive.rule: escape iff (fingerprint repeat at distance 2) OR (fp equals the running-minimum fingerprint of the window that closed at the phase-shifted boundary), each confirmed by full point equality

protocol.cap_rule: cap fixed BEFORE the run = ceil(cap_ratio x declared expected reports / nodes), min 1; cap-full report refused
protocol.detector: bounded: 2-cycle fp(K) vs fp(K-2) with minimum-fingerprint select + PRIME-67 checkpoint window whose running-minimum fingerprint is compared each step; every fp match is confirmed by FULL POINT EQUALITY; O(1) state
protocol.dp_field_production: low min(64,half) bits of the key: bits 0..63
protocol.endpoint_record: 26 B = route16 + dp-fp64 + owner-trail-id64 + step64; coefficients reconstructed by REPLAY from the trail start
protocol.module: experiments/protocol.py (single source for the toy and the ledger)
protocol.note: toy DP density and node counts are scaled down; the code path (predicate, router, fixed cap, refusal, endpoint store, endpoint match, exponent reconstruction, exact x verification) is the production path, imported from the same module the certificate reads
protocol.phase_rule: phase = mix64(start class key) mod 67, per trail
protocol.route_field_production: bits half..half+63 of the key: bits 128..191
